keywords.indexterm: scheduled maintenance items hybrid Starter & Generator (HSG) belt

conbody.p: Inspect all hybrid starter & generator belts for evidence of cuts, cracks, excessive wear or oil saturation and replace if necessary. Hybrid starter & generator belts should be checked periodically for proper tension and adjusted as necessary.

note.p: When you are inspecting the belt, place the ignition switch in the LOCK/OFF or ACC position.
